title: Chapter 137 The Lord'S Mansion Is Completed
content:
Chapter 137 The Lord'S Mansion Is Completed

At night, Wang Shuo's village-level administrative center was finally built!

Compared with the previous courtyard, it is more magnificent.

On the tall lintel, three large gilded characters "Lord's Mansion" were written in vermilion.

The stone lions on both sides were energetic and lifelike, as if they were coming to life.

There were bells hanging on the four corners of the eaves, and the breeze blew, making a crisp "ding-dong" sound.

Duan Wenxi led Wang Shuo and Suo Yong and walked in together.

The courtyard was larger than before, surrounded by corridors, and various patterns were carved on it.

There were plum blossoms, bamboos, rocks, and various birds and beasts.

The most spacious meeting room was paved with flat floor tiles, each of which was as smooth as a mirror.

In front of it was a domineering throne, and two green dragons were carved on the armrests.

On both sides, there were several chairs, all of which were exquisite and simple.

Wang Shuo was overjoyed when he saw it. This was simply too luxurious.

Shocked, Wang Shuo looked at Duan Wenxi and wondered, "How could these things be completed in such a short time?"

"Boss, you don't know that carpenters also have skills. They can complete the carving work with one skill, and they are more efficient when they cooperate with each other."

"Most of the materials we use are ready-made. We still have a lot of inventory for things like tiles."

Wang Shuo understood.

"Well done, I like this meeting hall!" Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction, looked at Duan Wenxi and gave him a thumbs up, praising him.

After the tour, Wang Shuo and his group returned to the meeting hall.

"There are many rooms here, you can choose one!" Wang Shuo said happily.

"Boss, this is your residence!"

"You can give the extra rooms to some distinguished guests to stay overnight, which will make you look particularly serious."

Then, Duan Wenxi said nervously: "I and Suo Yong and others plan to build a few more independent courtyards next to the lord's mansion. Do you think it's okay?"

Wang Shuo was in a good mood at this time and said with a smile: "Why not? I can't treat my brothers unfairly."

"Great, boss is the best!" Duan Wenxi's face was full of smiles, and he winked at Suo Yong.

"Then, boss, you should rest early, and we won't disturb you!"

"Go, you should rest early too! By the way, please invite Mr. Xiao Lao Teng to rest here!"

"Okay!" Duan Wenxi pulled Suo Yong and ran out quickly.

Outside the gate, Duan Wenxi smiled and said to Suo Yong: "Look, I told you that the boss would agree!"

"You are the one with the most clever ideas. This way, we don't have to squeeze together with other refugees! Haha..."

"Let's go and invite the architect together."

...

Early the next morning, Wang Shuo woke up, stretched his body, and felt comfortable all over.

I slept very well last night!

Mainly, this bed is so damn comfortable!

Wang Shuo opened the window and breathed in a breath of fresh air.

He was very energetic!

He couldn't help but sigh that Duan Wenxi was really a good subordinate.

He did things very well!

At the dining table in the temporary cafeteria, Wang Shuo looked at Xiao Laoteng and asked, "Did you rest well last night, sir?"

"Not bad." Xiao Laoteng took a bite of the meat bun and said casually.

Fuck, not bad?

It seems that this guy must have been used to a good life.

Wang Shuo also drank a mouthful of porridge, which flowed into his stomach very smoothly.

Instantly, a warm current spread throughout his body, warm and cozy!

Previously, he bought a lot of food in Nanshan Market, and also harvested a huge amount of wild animal meat, so now he has no shortage of food, and every meal is large and full.

Moreover, the food made by Zhou Keming, the chef of the territory, is also very delicious, and Wang Shuo always eats very full.

He even doubted whether he would get fat if he continued to eat like this.

If this matter was known by some people, they would definitely spit on him.

In this dangerous world, some people are starving, but Wang Shuo is worried about getting fat.
